items.summary: Margin register for run-25. NM-03 configs() TOCTOU: escapes as a correctness issue (price re-read at :622 immediately before the charge; _executeMint charges the pre-ramp price), residual is liveness only, and story-029 STRICTLY IMPROVES the pre-029 behaviour which could silently spend P. NM-04: every forceApprove writes an ABSOLUTE target, so correctness is independent of the token's allowance semantics; no FRONTRUN-APPROVE exposure since this contract is the approver and approve->spend is atomic. NM-05: both new boundaries (price > budget admitting equality, refund >= 1e6) are the semantically right operators - the MAGNITUDE of the second is DEDUP-25-04, not the operator. NM-07: Linear-Depletion class NOT APPLICABLE - zero signature hits (rewardRate/windowEnd/accPhusdPerShare/_recomputeSchedule); that family lives in NFTStakerDepletion*.sol which story-029 does not touch. Checked-with-no-match, NOT an error. NM-08: ERC777 / cross-function / read-only reentrancy all escape - _payRewards runs last with nonReentrant still held, every sibling reachable during a callback is onlyOwner, and the contract exposes no value-reporting view. P-04: the step-9/10 swap is SOUND (refund <= budget <= credited leaves at least P + D at the payout site); its only residual is the DoS tail folded into DEDUP-25-09. NM-01 and NM-02 are deliberately NOT parked here - their margins are load-bearing and are filed as DEDUP-25-06.

items.summary: Story-029 WIDENED the risk accepted under KI #15 (owner-accepted 2026-07-25) in three respects. (1) KI #15's own narrow-scope clause carves out at full severity '(d) the aggregate over-funding class ... about the pot being too LARGE relative to cost'; DEDUP-25-01 and DEDUP-25-03 are exactly class (d), i.e. INSIDE the carve-out, not inside the acceptance. (2) The acceptance's stated premise - 'the pot is by construction a fraction of the cost' - is falsified by DEDUP-25-02 (NudgeRatchet recycles 100% of the cost) and by DEDUP-25-05 (no code anywhere relates pot to cost). An acceptance covers the risk AS IT STOOD; it cannot cover a risk whose stated bound does not exist. (3) The accepted risk was static (framed as an owner over-funding event); the delivered risk is SELF-ARMING - 6-8 mints via the ratchet channel, 72-744 batches via the dust channel, with no funding event at all. The four claims KI #15 suppresses ('batching is profitable', 'sniped by MEV bots', 'payment token should not be whitelisted', 'setNudgeTokenWhitelist no longer rejects the payment token') are NOT re-filed and appear nowhere in the deduped output. Carve-outs (a)/(b)/(c) are clean.
